title: crocus lageniflorus var. aureus
intro: Crocus lageniflorus var. aureus, commonly known as Golden Crocus, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Iridaceae family. The health benefits of Golden Crocus include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat a variety of ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Golden Crocus include crocin, a powerful antioxidant, and other compounds that have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties.
